staging:
Scene 13 — Inside the Restaurant

11:45–12:35 · 50 sec · Service corridors

Ghost leads Trixie and Neon through the service entrance. Onyx monitors the guards outside while Byte coordinates remotely. A service robot nearly catches Ghost, who freezes motionless.

Shots: Corridor wide → security-camera POV → cat-eye close-up → robot passing → silent hand signals.
